title: affected.py skips selected test ids that no longer load
lead: When the map selects a test id that the working tree no longer defines (renamed or deleted), `tests/affected.py --run` drops it with a stderr note and asks for the full discover, instead of failing the run with a loader error.
findings_note: s277 relay 2026-10-15: `affected.py --run` with a borrowed map selected `test_Rows_BlockedReviewAndParked_ShowMarkerWithoutAClaimColumn`, which the slice had renamed, and the run reported an AttributeError instead of running the renamed test
boundary: **Not in this slice:** recording renames in the map, and changing which tests a diff selects.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A map is recorded at a commit; a slice that renames or deletes a test still has the old id in the map. `--run` passes the ids to unittest, which raises AttributeError for each missing one, so a green slice looks red until someone notices the error is a ghost. s277 hit it on 2026-10-15.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/affected.py`: before running, load each selected id with `unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromName`; collect the ones that fail to load, print them on stderr, run the rest, and exit 2 with "run the full discover" when any were dropped, since a renamed test may need running.
- `tests/test_affected.py`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the load check in `--run`.
3. Update CHANGELOG. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The full suite passes; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s292`, branch `feature/s292-affected-ghost-ids`. Commit only on the branch.
